native_compiler_version:
Apple clang version 21.0.0 (clang-2100.1.1.101)
Target: arm64-apple-darwin25.4.0
Thread model: posix
InstalledDir: /Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer/Toolchains/XcodeDefault.xctoolchain/usr/bin
scope: Ordinary Coax integration procedures with original bodies/#assert statements. Normal authority checks remain enabled. No native-check ABI, evaluator-parity, Wasm-execution or raster claim.

outcomes.original_name: spells: 1 picks Meteor Swarm, a click casts it at the inn, and the inn breaks; R stands it again
spells: casting leaves the camera where the player has it: no lift, no pull, no pan; a blast only shakes it, and it settles back
from the road in past the boulder by it: round the rock and on into the trees
watch: a meteor on the inn is a crime the watch hear and hunt you for; R stands the fallen up
watch: your own Thunderbolt at your feet hurts you and throws you; a Meteor Swarm on you kills you and you fall
no C line, no Ranger: nothing drawn for it, the rest draws
a quest save comes back for its player only
the painterly day: a cycling clock on a still page shows noon
Everglade's frames fit its declared budget
voice edits: the heard words go to the server as they are; its typed answer places, removes and undoes
the shared layer: a realm admin's EDIT opens edit mode and the board; an accepted card is placed; DONE closes it
spells: no ruleset, no bar; srd5 gives the four spells, and the town's pieces their SRD stats
spells: the Thunderbolt's bolt comes down and blasts a hole; a phone taps a slot, then the target
spells: a broken building stays broken, however long you are away, until R or a long rest
spells: aimed at a wall the aim takes the wall's face and the meteors burst on it; on the ground they fall from all but straight above
spells: nothing a spell leaves stays up in the air: the observatory's dome falls when its tower breaks, lies still, and stands again with it
spells: the Water Orb is water: cast at the inn every piece stands whole, and by a barrel the splash sends it rolling
spells: the bar is a compact tray: 26-unit icons 29 apart, 8 over the bottom, each slot's picture; a held finger shows its card and doesn't cast
spells: the bar's rows: Shift reaches the second, over the first on a wide screen, Ctrl's beside them; a phone shows one row and a switcher
spells: on a phone the bar is one row low on the screen, the rest a tap away in the tray, every slot reachable
the bar: a swap moves the spells, not the keys; its text round-trips; a bad or older text is refused
the bar: Shift and a drag swaps two slots and casts nothing; let go off the bar, nothing moves; a phone holds and drags
abilities: Black Tentacles rise in a 20-foot square, seize the props in reach and hold them up, and restrain who fails
abilities: a guard hunting you on a Wall of Stone's far side runs round it, never through it; when it falls, straight on
frost: an Ice Storm hurts who stands in it (you too), leaves walkable ice on a pond that holds you over it, then thin ice that breaks
frost: a Sleet Storm knocks down who fails its save, puts out a fire, hides what is behind it, and Shift+6 ends it
frost: you slip on the ice and lie Prone for a moment, unable to move; in the sleet a fall ends your Concentration
tide: Control Water floods, parts a dry trench to walk, turns the current and whirls; Shift+8 steps through them and ends it
grove: Moonbeam shines where you click, its radiance falls on who stands in it (you too), a click moves it, and Shift+- ends it
grove: Ctrl+1 lights Produce Flame in your hand (a light on the town); hurled, it strikes, scorches and sets debris burning; Starry Wisp leaves its mark starlit; Poison Spray's mist hangs
grove: Shillelagh's staff strikes in reach for 1d10 + 3 force; Elementalism beckons each element in turn; Entangle restrains who fails, slows you in it, and a lost Concentration ends it
wild: Ctrl+7 Faerie Fire outlines who fails in its cube (attacks at them have Advantage; outlined, the town's at you have it), Ctrl+8 Healing Word heals them or you, never the dead
wild: Spike Growth's thorns tear whoever walks in them (you too) 2d4 a 5 feet; Call Lightning's cloud gathers over you and its bolt strikes 3d10 where you click under it
wild: Wall of Fire rises across your view (5d8 to who is in it, its far side burns), the town walks round it; fire on the grass spreads, burns who stands in it, and water puts it out
fire: Fire Storm sets a house burning; a bolt catches wood about half the time; fire spreads along a fence, burns it to collapse, and frost puts it out
fire: the observatory's dome breaks under a Meteor Swarm into slabs that fall to the ground; R stands it again
trees: a meteor beside the tree line fells the trees away from the blast; they lie where they fell, near and far; R stands them again
trees: flame lights a tree; it burns black, its leaves go, it spreads to the crowns by it; water puts it out; nothing grows back
trees: a bolt by a tree strikes it and splits it; fire deep in the woods is no crime, by the palisade the watch hears it
circle: Conjure Animals' pack tears whoever comes within 10 feet (you too), Polymorph makes a frog of them or a bear of you, Mass Cure Wounds heals six

circle: Sunbeam blinds or burns down its line (Blinded, their blows at you have Disadvantage), Wall of Thorns tears who is in it (you too) and the town walks round it, Fire Storm's ten cubes burn and catch the grass
storm: Sunburst burns and blinds in 60 feet (you too, your attacks then at Disadvantage), Storm of Vengeance's rounds fall on whoever is under it (you too)
storm: Shapechange's mammoth (126 Temporary Hit Points, gores, no spells) turns bear, wolf, then you; Wild Resurgence makes a wolf of you; Speak with Animals; R is a Long Rest
polar: Ray of Frost hits for 2d8 and slows, Fog Cloud hides who is in it, Hold Person paralyzes (your blows at Advantage) until a save, Cone of Cold freezes the 60-foot cone and never you
rubble: a falling chunk strikes the guard under it, a slow one doesn't; the blocks of a crumbled panel strike you
audit: Meteor Swarm, the Thunderbolt and the Mega Thunderbolt blast the guard they strike; the Water Orb's splash too
audit: Wind Wall's rising, Gust of Wind's push and Thunderwave's boom reach the guard in front of you
audit: Black Tentacles crush and restrain the guard in their square, and the one who walks in
audit: Ice Storm's hail hurts the guard under it; Sleet Storm knocks down the one who walks in
audit: Moonbeam sears the guard who walks into it; Produce Flame, Starry Wisp and Poison Spray strike a guard
audit: Shillelagh's staff and Ray of Frost strike a guard; Hold Person paralyzes one; Entangle restrains one
audit: Faerie Fire outlines a guard; Spike Growth tears the one who walks in it; Call Lightning's bolt strikes one
audit: Wall of Fire and Wall of Thorns burn and tear the guard who walks into them after they rise
audit: Fire Storm burns the guard in its cubes and the one who runs into them while they roar; each shows its number
audit: Conjure Animals' pack, Sunbeam, Sunburst, Storm of Vengeance and Cone of Cold hurt a guard; Polymorph makes one a frog
audit: an Ice Knife bursts on a guard, Polymorph makes one a frog, Reverse Gravity lifts one or makes them hold on
audit: the grass afire burns the guard who walks into it
audit: Produce Flame hurled at a guard turns them on you, hit or miss
audit: Produce Flame hurled at a building turns the guard who sees or hears it
audit: a Produce Flame landing beside a guard turns them
watch: you die levitating 10 m up and stand again at the Road In on the ground, Levitate ended
watch: WANTED 5 calls the company in at the gate; they are drawn in their ranks' colours, casters bare-handed, with five stars lit
first goal: a fresh save draws its goal line in the first frame, Bram marked; each step done moves it on, and a quest taken ends it
reply: the reply page takes its words and seed, stands you facing the house and waits for the town

emission.kind: normal Coax C library emission; authority enabled
